keyEvents.text: Aleksandar Katai (Red Star Belgrade) is shown the red card for violent conduct.
Domingo Berlanga (Inter Club D'Escaldes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Álex Sánchez (Inter Club D'Escaldes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Red Star Belgrade 0, Inter Club D'Escaldes 0.
